item.title: Proxmox Best Practices - Guest Storage
item.description: How I set cache, aio, iothread, and discard on Proxmox VMs, decided by how each VM is used rather than the OS inside it, plus the ZFS foundations that keep those choices safe to leave alone for years.

item.title: Proxmox Best Practices - Guest CPU Types
item.description: How I pick a Proxmox VM CPU type: host versus the x86-64-vN virtual types, the Spectre and Meltdown flags those types quietly leave off, and why host is usually the wrong default on Windows.
